notes.title: Sumatra: Fate of Yandi now available in Spanish, French and German!
notes.content:
Hi everyone,

We've just released an updated version of Sumatra: Fate of Yandi that contains full support for French, German and Spanish languages, as well as some minor bug fixes. 

[b]PLEASE NOTE: [/b]
Existing save files will no longer work with this new version of the game, due to limitations in the game engine. However, if your game has updated you can still rollback to the previous version by following these easy steps:

1. Right click on the game in your Steam library, and select 'Properties...'
2. Click 'Betas'
3. There is a box that says "Enter beta access code..." - enter the following password: [b]rollbackrollback[/b], then click "Check Code"
4. Select "rollback - Pre-translation release" from the "Select the beta you would like to opt into" menu.

The previous version of the game will then download and update, and you'll be able to load your save and continue your game :)
Apologies for this inconvenience!

We hope new players will enjoy this chance to play the game in their native languages.

Thanks for your support,
Shaun
[i][b]Cloak and Dagger Games[/b][/i]

notes.title: Sumatra: Fate of Yandi - tiny update
notes.content:
Hi all!

[b]Thank you [/b]so much for your support with Sumatra: Fate of Yandi! The launch has gone so well and we've been getting lots of lovely feedback - we are glad you are enjoying the game :)

I've just updated the game with a tiny patch that fixes an issue with a particular achievement sometimes not unlocking, as well as a couple of tiny cosmetic adjustments here and there.

Happy adventuring!

Thanks,
Shaun
[i][b]Cloak and Dagger Games[/b][/i]
